profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Twilio
profile.summary: Enthusiastic Engineer, looking to shape the future and bettering our lives. I'd best describe myself as a reader/Writer of code by trade, of literature by virtue. For any professional inquiry, I'd prefer to discuss with an in-house recruiter over a third-party personnel. Please embed answer to the following question to any professional inquiry, so I know you've read my profile and not copy-pasting: What's 29 + 13?

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Teams and Channels backend, Microsoft Teams

Distributed Systems back-end. .NET Core, C#, Azure, MSFT technology stack.

Delivered a cross-org wide feature to delineate identities from Native Identity to externally authenticated
identities. This was a major disambiguation to launch “Shared Channels” effort with conjunction to Native
Identity.
Overhauled an internal on-call support process and documentation standards, and delivered an internal tool to
securely access/impact internal customer data
Delivered “at-mentions” feature for cross-tenant scenario for Teams Enterprise.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on mission-critical systems to Customer Service applications at Amazon. If you've ever chatted, had a phone conversation with, or exchanged an e-mail with our very competent and emphatic Customer Service Agents, you've used system my team and I worked diligently to maintain.

I'm exposed to problems with industry-best, Amazon-scale issues and solutions. We are industry-leading experts of Distributed systems and operational architectures.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
My team builds Amazon's Customer Service Communication platform, the core communications component for Amazon's world-class Customer Service operation. If you've ever called, e-mailed, or chatted with an Amazon Customer Service Agent, then you have used software I and my talented team built. Our platform and active service is used by several hundereds of distinct groups within Amazon, its subsidaries, and external partners.

In this role I took ownership of multiple critical systems, brought stability to the said systems, and took an important role to move our systems off of Oracle systems; if you've read a news coverage of how Amazon would be off of Oracle systems, my team did one of the hardest portion - dealing with legacy code.

This position allowed me to grow even faster than I had imagined, which earned my promotion.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Assigned on Hubub(hubub.com) project.
Hubub is a topic-based social plugin that provides dynamic community for enterprise-to-customer solution.
Contributed in architecture of modularized custom-event based front-end framework that extends KnockoutJS.
Implemented seamless twitter-embedded widgets and integrated WYSWIG content input.
Worked on architecture for angularJS migration.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Foresight 2.5:
- Maintained legacy code of Foresight 2.5, a customer-experience enhancement product. 
- Implemented a mobile-friendly site for a key client, using jQuery Mobile.
< ASP.NET(C#), Javascript, JQuery Mobile >

Foresight 3:
 - Developed major parts of dynamic front-end for the newer version of Foresight 2.5.
 - Refactored the site to be cross-platform up to, and including, IE8.
 - Enhanced memory/processing performance of AngularJS client codebase.
 - Maintained and code-reviewed for later commits for the front-end codebase.
< JavaScript, AngularJS, Bootstrap, HTML5/CSS. >

Foresight Mobile:
 - Developed, and maintained the iOS mobile version of Foresight 2.5 for four major clients.
< Objective C, Cocoa Framework >

positions.title: Framework Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as a part of client framework developer team for NexJ CRM application.
- Maintained old code and developed new features when requested.
- Dealt with Javascript re-factoring of a scroll-bar module and browser authorization issues.
 < Java, JavaScript, HTML CSS, Apache webserver. >

positions.title: Framework Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as a part of client framework developer team for NexJ CRM application.
- Maintained old code and developed new features when requested.
- Dealt with Javascript re-factoring of a scroll-bar module and browser authorization issues.
 < Java, JavaScript, HTML CSS, Apache webserver. >

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as a part of software developer team for a SPM application Varicent.
- Fixed bugs, implemented requested enhancements, and handled support issues.
- Dealt with client application, and enhanced web presentation with third party technology
 < C#, .NET 3.5, Java, Javascript, Microsoft SQL server. >

positions.title: CS Teaching Assistance
positions.description:
- Worked as a full-time tutor of a Computer Science course.
- Taught Scheme, C, and basic data structure ideas.
- Handled student communication via tutorials, one-to-one sessions, and maintaining course webpage.
- Designed, proposed, and completed a project to improve marking consistency.
Bash, C, Scheme, HTML
